display_threshold.note: F1 against labelled positives; unlabelled rows are not negatives

input_support.interpretation: Exact predictor/source/function/role/context identities with both classes in train and calibration; sequence features within their observed profile ranges. Necessary coverage only; no joint-distribution, taxonomic-transfer or calibration guarantee.

locus_model.probability_target: none of the proposed candidates is experimentally supported, beyond what the label frequency c explains

pu.tree_objective: newton_boosted_unbiased_pu_logistic_loss: init=logit(pi), g_pos=-pi*w/W_P, h_pos=0, g_unl=w*sigmoid(z)/W_U, h_unl=w*sigmoid(z)*(1-sigmoid(z))/W_U, leaf_denominator_clipped>=1e-12

truth.locus_supervision: per-genome function/role competitions under PU marginal likelihood
